classification_rule.mechanically_enforced: A production constructor, typestate, parser, reducer, or CLI rejection boundary enforces the scoped claim.
classification_rule.test_backed_only: Code or a contract test exercises the claim, but the supported CLI vertical slice does not expose an end-to-end production route for it.
classification_rule.documentation_only: The current workspace has no executable production route establishing the claim.

premises.claim: There is no HTTP client, LLM SDK, or asynchronous runtime dependency.
premises.qualification: The listed workspace.dependencies are exact, but crate-local dependencies additionally include rusqlite and optional base64.

premises.claim: The only review CLI route is review --fixture double-submit; the remaining supported families are schema and gate.
The product currently has no live-model execution route; a local process adapter is feasible without HTTP, SDK, or async dependencies but has not yet been built.
The fixed route traverses authority, obligation, evidence, verification, decision, terminal report authority, and V5 report generation.

vertical_slice.stage: isolated temporary Store and fixed M4 prefix
source M5 gluing and source authority inspection
source index rebuild and target V5 publication/index validation
incremental mapping, obligation selection, and partial reruns
fixed raw reviewer response and strict structured admission
target gluing and verifier contract binding
target M5 completion and proof-bound terminal marker
dual-run terminal report authority and canonical V5 generation

capabilities.property: The supported CLI review surface is closed to exactly one fixture route.
The fixed route executes the persisted M4/M5/M6 continuation rather than printing a committed report fixture.
A fixed input produces canonical, byte-identical V5 report output.
Program facts, reviewer claims, evidence, verification, and decisions use separate typed records.
Coverage axes are derived relative to an explicit non-empty obligation denominator.
capabilities.scope: typed report generation; serialized validation is weaker
capabilities.phase_b_note: Serialized report validation does not bind the denominator back to source rows; omission, inflation, and substitution were accepted.

capabilities.property: Reviewer input is a source-closed byte request with no filesystem path or tool channel.
AI reviewer output remains proposed and unreviewed and cannot directly label itself accepted.
capabilities.scope: V5 claim contract and report schema

capabilities.property: A human decision is admitted only against an exact actor, authority, capability, run, snapshot, universe, property, claim, and validity grant.
capabilities.scope: Core/Store fresh and replay authority before report serialization
capabilities.phase_b_note: A serialized decision actor/authority mutation was accepted because CLI validation does not recompute record hashes or replay authority.

capabilities.property: Evidence and verification must form a connected, passed, claim-bound trace, with freshness when required.
capabilities.phase_b_note: Serialized evidence and fresh-coverage mutations were accepted without replaying this aggregate validation.

capabilities.property: Local review sections are glued before the fixed global result is projected.
V5 report generation requires a non-cloneable, non-serializable dual-run terminal authority, not caller-supplied rows.
The V5 JSON shape is closed and schema-external values are rejected.
Gate rejects malformed, unsupported, and locally inconsistent V5 reports and maps valid embedded status to exit codes.
capabilities.scope: report-only CLI gate; not a signature or journal replay verifier
capabilities.phase_b_note: The broader fail-closed claim was broken by a locally coherent pass rewrite retaining invalid derived ID/body_hash values.

capabilities.property: The durable journal and derived indexes reject body, chain, CAS, or stale-index tampering on replay/rebuild.
capabilities.phase_b_note: Not independently injected into the private Store typestate; the serialized report boundary was tested instead.

capabilities.property: Rust/Git ingestion can execute against an arbitrary admitted local repository snapshot.
capabilities.scope: library and ingest tests; absent from supported CLI review route

capabilities.property: The current product can call a live LLM through a provider adapter.
capabilities.note: This is an absent current capability, not a technical impossibility: codex exec and claude --print can be invoked through std::process. Phase C is the implementation target.

capabilities.property: Live provider calls are isolated, recorded, and replayable without recalling the provider.
The generic Stage 0 through Stage 10 pipeline is available for arbitrary repositories and profiles.
Parallel independent obligation execution with stable logical commit ordering is implemented.
ReviewGraphen improves defect detection over free-form review through its product execution path.
capabilities.note: M7 is a separate non-authority benchmark and cannot establish this product-path claim.

capabilities.property: The current Rust implementation executes over HigherGraphen crates.
capabilities.note: Cargo manifests contain no HigherGraphen crate dependency; the mapping is currently conceptual.
